lines.text: The writer says the Corinthians very easily put up with someone who proclaims a different Jesus.
The writer considers himself in no way inferior to the super-apostles, though he is not a polished speaker.
When in need among the Corinthians, the writer was supplied by brothers from Galatia and was no burden.
The writer calls the men false apostles, and says Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
